content: Pita Kǝ Joon, Ntoom Nennan Mo
Kaaɗe Pita kǝ Joon, mo ɗi nkaa leshap ngurum nǝ mo, ɓǝ pak pris mo, kǝ ngwe ɗeɗes mǝ nentap Lu Naan ɗeɗes, kǝ pak nen Sadusi mo, mo jì pǝ mo ɗi.
Nǝ láa mmo mɓut, mbǝɗe jeplep ɗevǝl nǝ mo, nkaa kám ngurum mo nǝ, Jesu kǝ yool a peemúut. Ɗe nǝ kám nǝ, katɗang gurum mo murep, ɓǝ mon nyool a peemúut mmǝnǝ.
Mo yaa Pita kǝ Joon, ɓǝ mo dǝm shoot mo teer nlushoot, mbǝɗe kansǝǝn kǝ cìn.
Jir aasǝ gurum mo ɗes mo shinzeen mpwoo nǝ, ɗe daas mo kus kǝ wul ngal paat.
Dǝɗaar nǝ, ɓǝ nen taatǝleng mǝ nen Yahudi mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mo mo, kǝ nenkám Wàar Mosis mo, mo kuur ashak, nJerusalem.
Kǝ Anas ɗewur a pris ɗeɗes met jir, wur ɗi ashak kǝ mo, kǝ Kayafas, kǝ Joon kǝ Alekzanda, kǝ nen ɗe mo a ɗang mǝ pris ɗeɗes met jir nǝ zak.
Kaaɗe mo lep kǝ mmo dǝm jì kǝ Pita kǝ Joon, ɓǝ mo le mmo ɗar ntoom mo. Yaksǝ mo ɗoom tal pǝ mo nǝnee, <<A shi ɗeɗes mǝ wii, koo a nɗǝǝn sǝm mǝ wii, ɓǝ wuu cìn mbii ɗesǝ yii?>>
Mbǝɗǝ Pita wur gam kǝ Riin Ɗeɓang, ɓǝ wur lap mmo nǝnee, <<Wun nen taatǝleng mǝ gurum mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mo.
Katɗang wu tokɗyeel mun cicinsǝ a mbǝ ɗeret ɗe mo cìn ngwar ɗe dǝ wur a kurumkut sǝ, kǝ nkaa ar ɗe gwar nǝ wur ɗee a ɗebǝbar sǝ,

ɓǝ wu yit kǝ mbii ɗesǝ ɗee a mǝ man pǝ wun ɗi, kǝ nen Isreil mo jir nee, a shi sǝm mǝ Jesu Kristi ngu Nazaret, ɗe wu pwas wur nkaa shiyeep ɗewur muut, ɗangnaan yool kǝ wur a peemúut. A mbǝ Jesu, ɗang gwar ɗesǝ wur ɗar ntoom fuu a ɗebǝbar.
A Jesu a ngwe ɗe mo kǝ ten ran pwoo nkaa wur nɗǝǝn ɓǝǝt-haal mǝ Naan nǝnee, <Ngǝk ɗe wun nen ɗyiklu mo wu cii, ɓǝ a nǝ ɗee a ngǝk ɗekǝkoop met jir nɗǝǝn kwang mǝ lu nǝ.>
Baa gurum mon nwaa mak kat mee ɓam pǝ mee ngwe ɗi kas. Mbǝɗǝ nɗǝǝn yil ɗesǝ jir, ɓǝ baa Naan kǝ shin ɗeɗes mmee ngwe, mbǝkǝ nwur ɓam gurum mo ɗi kas, tǝng a nɗǝǝn sǝm mǝ Jesu Kristi ɓejee ɗak>>

Kaaɗe mo naa Pita kǝ Joon, mo leshap ɓalɓal, baa kǝ mee kǝǝrmuut kas, ɓǝ nǝ aapwoo mmo, mbǝɗe baa Pita kǝ Joon mo a mee mbii kas, kǝzak baa mo kǝ kam tang ran dǝm jong kas zak nǝ tang mo pǝtuup nǝ ɗe mo ashak kǝ Jesu.
Baa nenɓeetpwoo nǝ mo mak cìn mee mbii kas, mbǝɗe mo naa gwar ɗe mo kǝ bar wur nǝ, wur ɗar ɗi ashak kǝ Pita kǝ Joon.
Aasǝ, ɓǝ mo le kǝ mmo pwat kǝ Pita kǝ Joon, mbǝkǝ mmo ɓeet ɗi ashak mbii ɗe mon ncìn kǝ mo.

Mo sat nǝnee, <<Mmun ncìn a mii kǝ nen ɗesǝ mo yii? Azeen-zeen gurum ɗe moo tong nɗǝǝn nJerusalem jir, mo kǝ man nǝ, Naan kǝ cìn mee mbii lukshik ɗeɗes nsar kǝ Pita kǝ Joon, ɗang baa mun mmak cíipwoo nǝ kas.
Mbǝkǝ taji gurum mo ɗes mo kǝlǝng pwoo ɗesǝ nǝ kas, ɓǝ wu yit kǝ mmun cíi mmo nǝ, taji mo baa leshap ɗi mmee gurum nɗǝǝn sǝm mǝ Jesu kas.>>
Kaaɗe mo waa pet Pita kǝ Joon mo ɗel, ɓǝ mo sat mmo ɓalɓal nǝnee, <<Taji wu baa wu sat meepwoo, koo wu kám mee mbii nɗǝǝn sǝm mǝ Jesu kas.>>
Ɗangɓe Pita kǝ Joon mo lap mmo nǝnee, <<Wun shikáa fuu wu ɓeet, kyet nǝn nret nNaan nyit kǝ mmun cìn a mbii ɗe wun wu sat aa? Koo a mbii ɗe Naan sat yii?
Baa mun mbǝ nook leshap nkaa mbii ɗe mu naa, kǝ mbii ɗe mu kǝlǝng kas.>>
Aɓwoon ɗe mo kǝ gwak mo ɓalɓal kǝ lekǝǝrmuut mmo, ɓǝ mo ɓwet mo, baa nenɓeetpwoo nǝ mo mak cin mee kar ɗebish mPita kǝ Joon kas, mbǝɗe gurum nǝ mo jir, mon nkaa kwoop Naan mbǝ mbii ɗe mo naa nǝ cìn.
Gwar ɗe mo bar wur shi ar ɗe mǝ aapwoo nǝ, ɓit wur mo met nlaarfeer.
Nenshínzeen Mo Ɗangnaan Mbǝ Leshap Ɗeret Nǝ
Kaaɗe mo ɓwet Pita kǝ Joon, ɓǝ mo dǝm pǝ nniyee fur mo ɗi. Mo sat nniyee fur nǝ mo, mbii ɗe pris ɗenan-nan mo, kǝ nen ɗenan-nan mo sat mmo jir.
Kaaɗe nen shinzeen nǝ mo kǝlǝng pwoo mǝnǝ, ɓǝ mo ɗangnaan shi pǝtuup mǝndong, nǝnee, <<Daa Ɗehai, ɗe waa a le ɗeng kǝ yil, kǝ am kuur mo, kǝ mbii ɗe mo nɗǝǝn mo jir.

Gyet a shi Riin Ɗeɓang, ɓǝ waa a leshap mpwoo mǝ kǝrem fwaa ɗewur a puunkaam fun Devit nǝnee <A mii le ɗang gurum ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas, mo yool ntuup yii? A mii le ɗang gurum nǝ mo kǝ pan ɗebish nɗǝǝn pǝtuup fur mo, mbǝ cìn mbii ɗebuu mo yii?
Deskoom ɗe mǝ yil nǝ mo,

content.text: mo kǝ ɗak sut fur mo mbǝ lek,
mbǝkǝ mmo yaa lek ɗi kǝ Daa Naan

content: Mbǝɗǝ azeen-zeen nɗǝǝn pee nkaam ɗesǝ, ɓǝ Herot kǝ Pontus Pailet, ashak kǝ nen ɗe baa mo a nen Yahudi mo kas, kǝ nen Isreil mo, mo kǝ kuur ashak, mbǝkǝ mmo ɗee a shaarlek mǝ nguɗak fwaa Jesu Ɗeɓang, ɗe waa a bǝlǝp wur, ɗe a gha le nwur ɗee a Kristi.
Mo kuur ashak, mbǝkǝ mmo cìn koo a mbii ɗeɗangyii ɗe a gha aa ten a le shi iiko fwaa kǝ reɓet fwaa nǝ, mbii nǝ mon ncìn a kǝsǝ.
Yaksǝ Daa Naan a naa kǝǝrmuut ɗe moo le mmun. A shínɓal mmun kǝrem fwaa mo, mbǝkǝ mmun satpwoo fwaa ɗi ɓalɓal, baa ashak kǝ kǝǝrmuut kas.
A le kǝn iiko fwaa nǝ bar gurum mo, kǝ a le kǝ mbii lukshik mo kǝ mbii aapwoo mo cìn nɗǝǝn sǝm mǝ nguɗak fwaa Jesu Ɗeɓang.>>
Kaaɗe mo kyes ɗangnaan mǝnǝ, ɓǝ pee ɗe moo kuur ɗi ashak, nǝ sǝǝn. Mo gam kǝ Riin Ɗeɓang jir, yaksǝ mo yaa satpwoo mǝ Naan ɓalɓal agaak, baa ashak kǝ kǝǝrmuut kas.
Nenshínzeen Nǝ Mo Lelong Fur Mo Ashak
Nen ɗe mo shinzeen nJesu jir, ɓǝ pan mo mo, kǝ mǝse mo mo ɗee a ɗemǝndong jir zak. Baa mee gurum nɗǝǝn mo mak sat nǝ, long fin nǝ a mǝnǝ mbǝshin kas, ɗang mo le mbii fur mo jir, ashak.
Jeplep nǝ mo ɗee a langtǝng shi iiko, nkaa yool mǝ Daa Jesu a peemúut. Daa Naan le ɗeret nkaa mo jir hakyeng.
Baa mee ngwe ɗee, a ngujeel nɗǝǝn mo koo mǝndong kas, mbǝɗe nen ɗe mo kǝ maar mo, kǝ lu mo, ɓǝ mo sǝrep mo jir,
ɓǝ mo jì shin shool mǝ mbii ɗe mo kǝ sǝrep nǝ mon njeplep mǝ Jesu nǝ mo. Ɓǝ jeplep nǝ mo shwap shool nǝ nnen shinzeen nǝ mo nciit-nciit, mbǝkǝ koo ngwe ɗeɗangyii, ɓǝ wur kat mbii ɗewur kǝ reɓet.
Kaaɗe mo nkaa cìn mǝnǝ kǝsǝ, ɓǝ Josep ngu Livai, ɗewur put a nyil nSaiprus, kǝ ɗe jeplep nǝ mo le sǝm nwur a Barnabas, (ɗe shii mǝ sǝm mǝnǝ a nǝ, Ngwe ɗewur kǝ caapee).
Wur mang mee maar fin seet, ɓǝ wur jì shin shool nǝ jir njeplep nǝ mo.
